t2.thesis: WDC is a high-volatility AI-storage name that reports after the close with a large implied move; the stock has already sold off about 49% from its high and the setup is balanced, so no edge beyond the base rate.
reasons: Base rate ~54% for AMC events, but the semis cluster sits at 48%, which offsets it
Last 4 prints: 1 up, 3 down despite beats each time, so beats are priced in and the reaction has been negative
Stock is about 49% below its 52-week high, down 18% over 1m, and just bounced 6%, which leaves room for either a relief rally or a continued sell-off
Implied move is about 8.4% with IV about 1.56x realized vol, so the options market is already pricing large uncertainty

Supportive factors: guidance implied beat (consensus EPS $4.08 vs guide midpoint $4.00), upward estimate revisions, Morgan Stanley bullish; offset by competition and AI-funding concerns (CXMT, price target cut)
t2.deciding_variable: Forward guidance for FQ2 (revenue, gross margin) and commentary on HDD pricing and hyperscaler demand durability versus competition and AI-funding worries.

prior.from: I3 overall validation hit rate 54.2%, AMC 53.8%, semis cluster 47.9%, hardware_networking 58.6%; WDC sits between the two clusters, so I used the overall rate of ~0.54.

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. I have no information on how WDC's stock moved after its 2026-10-22 earnings report, since that falls after my knowledge cutoff.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 4 points from 0.54 to 0.50: the weak last-4 reaction record on beats and the sell-off in memory/storage names offset the positive estimate revisions and the oversold bounce.

theses.expected: Rise: beat and guide above the consensus ~$4.4B-ish level, with margin expansion
theses.mechanism: Oversold stock with a depressed multiple (forward PE ~11) re-rates on confirmed demand durability
theses.wrong_if: Guidance is merely in line, or gross margin guide stalls below ~56%

theses.expected: Fall: beat but 'sell the news' as in the last three prints
theses.mechanism: The stock ran a lot, expectations are high, and any sign of peak pricing or supply additions triggers de-rating
theses.wrong_if: Management raises long-term agreements visibility and the stock opens higher

theses.expected: Large move either way, tracking Seagate's print read-through
theses.mechanism: Peer HDD results and sector sentiment shift the open independent of WDC's own numbers
theses.wrong_if: Seagate's results are muted and WDC trades on its own guidance

key_observations: FQ2 revenue and gross margin guidance versus consensus
Hyperscaler demand and long-term agreement commentary
Buyback pace and share count after the convert redemption
Reaction in Seagate and Sandisk after the print
